title: Schedules and assets: pure schedule math, DB-backed schedules, asset use cases
statusReason: Static and golden-math verification pass. typecheck, build and ALL DB tests (WP-1, WP-2a, WP-2b, WP-3, WP-4, F8-F10a) did not run: no Postgres and no node_modules here. Money-critical code; nothing is PASS until pnpm test:finance-db is green in the real checkout.

commit.workingTree: Uncommitted; cumulative with WP-2b, F8, WP-3; bound by content in fin-provenance-manifest.json (71 files, regenerated).

baselineProof.method: The ORIGINAL generateAmortizationSchedule/generateDepreciationSchedule (lib/finance-accounting.ts as of WP-3, sha256 40afb1253b83662199ff85adf17513b16f2fb2b059efcae33cd20becc1ae7674) were executed with the DB and drizzle-orm stubbed; every row passed to insert().values() was recorded. The extracted pure functions must reproduce each case's canonicalised-rows SHA-256.
baselineProof.coverage: Amortization: principals 0..1,000,000 x rates 0..36% x terms 1..60 months x 4 start dates (month-end clamping incl. Feb 29) plus dueDate fallback and null amount/rate. Depreciation: both methods x costs 0..250,000 x salvage 0..300,000 (incl. salvage > cost) x lives 1..60 x 4 start dates, plus totalValue/purchaseDate fallbacks.
mutationChecks: reordered float operations in monthly rate -> fails
baselineProof.limit: Resolution of defaults (null amount to 0, start-date fallback chain) stays in the persistence functions and is covered by the golden inputs but only exercised against a real DB by the unrun wp4 tests. Guards (no method / life <= 0 return [] with no insert) are unchanged code, characterised in the capture.

oldToNew.lib/finance-accounting.ts: now a pure re-export shim; public surface identical (34 before, 34 after)

behaviorChanges: F9: schedule delete+insert is now one transaction per generator (same results on success; a failed insert no longer leaves no schedule).
F10a: depreciation post uses a conditional claim (status <> 'posted'); concurrent requests no longer double-post the journal; losers return the already-posted row.
Everything else moved without logic edits. Route validation, status codes and messages unchanged.

newFindings.summary: depreciation journal failure swallowed; journal, schedule flip and asset totalValue update not atomic; out-of-order posting leaves totalValue at the last-posted period
all 43 money-like finance columns are real (float32): 1,000,000.01 stored as 1,000,000.00; whole units lost above 16,777,216. Needs a schema decision; out of programme scope.
